name: page-header
title: Page Header
description: The top of every KOC application screen — an eyebrow (the in-app path), a light large h1, actions and meta — plus SectionHeading for a long page's numbered parts ('02 — Figures'). The title is an h1 because the app shell contributes no heading, so without it a screen has no top-level landmark at all.
docs: Keep breadcrumbs shallow: they render as the eyebrow, and Directorate and Group are identity, not navigation. The title is weight 300 by design (rig3, 2026-10-25) — hierarchy comes from size and air, so do not bold it back.
